import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = 10;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static int[][] p = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int[] id = new int[64];
    static int ki = 0;
    static long[] X = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] Y = new long[1 << 20];

    static long qp(long x, long p) {
        long ret = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) ret = ret * x % mod;
            x = x * x % mod;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static long inv(long x) {
        return qp(x, mod - 2);
    }

    static void add(long[] arr, int index, long value) {
        arr[index] = (arr[index] + value) % mod;
    }

    static void add(long[] arr, int index, long value, boolean dummy) {
        arr[index] = (arr[index] + value) % mod;
    }

    static void sub(long[] arr, int index, long value) {
        arr[index] = (arr[index] - value) % mod;
        if (arr[index] < 0) arr[index] += mod;
    }

    static void FWT(long[] P, int opt) {
        int N = 1 << 20;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i <<= 1) {
            for (int p = i >> 1, j = 0; j < N; j += i) {
                for (int k = j; k < j + p; k++) {
                    if (opt == 1) {
                        P[k] = (P[k] + P[k + p]) % mod;
                    } else {
                        P[k] = (P[k] - P[k + p]) % mod;
                        if (P[k] < 0) P[k] += mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();

            }
        }

        if (n < 6) {
            for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
                p[i][i] = 1;
            }
            n = 6;
        }

        int A = (1 << 6) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                id[i] = ki++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A;
            int msk2 = (i >> 6) & A;
            int msk3 = (i >> 12) & A;
            int mask = 0;
            long pp = 1;

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk1 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[0][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[0][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk2 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[1][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[1][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk3 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[2][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[2][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            if (pp == 0) continue;

            for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
                if (((msk1 >> a) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                        if (a == b) continue;
                        if (((msk2 >> b) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
                                if (a == c || b == c) continue;
                                if (((msk3 >> c) & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nmsk = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                                    mask |= 1 << id[nmsk];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            add(X, mask, pp);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A;
            int msk2 = (i >> 6) & A;
            int msk3 = (i >> 12) & A;
            int mask = 0;
            long pp = 1;

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk1 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[3][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[3][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk2 >> j) & 1) == 1) {

                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[4][j])) % mod;

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
